subject: Partner request: SI accelerator co-fund split and redemption instructions
messages:
From: Priya Desai <priya@cloudnorth.io>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: mohammed@edgeaccelerator.org
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: co-fund credits for Edge Accelerator cohort - split and redemption

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday — the cohort kickoff for Edge Accelerator starts June 5 and we have two SI-led pilots lined up that would benefit from Redwood trial credits. We have a total ask of $25k in promotional credits allocated across two partners (CloudNorth + EdgeAccelerator run jointly).

Key asks:
- Can Redwood approve a co-funded promo allocation of $25k for the cohort (billable to RDW partner credits)?
- We need instructions for redemption (marketplace vs voucher code) and any guardrails you require (per-seat caps, timeboxed usage).
- Requested timeline: credits issued and visible in Marketplace/NDA pool by 29 May so SIs can onboard customers.

I attached our proposal and a simple usage plan.

Appreciate your help — Priya

--
Priya Desai
Head of Partnerships, CloudNorth
priya@cloudnorth.io
+1 415-555-0162
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: co-fund credits for Edge Accelerator cohort - split and redemption

Forwarding Priya's request — short timeline. Vanessa, can you confirm whether we can:

1) Issue $25k in promo credits as a partner-funded pool scoped to CloudNorth/EdgeAccelerator pilots (marketplace voucher or escrowed allocation).
2) Split the allocation 60/40 (CloudNorth 15k / EdgeAccelerator 10k) and surface two redemption paths (marketplace entitlement + per-customer voucher).
3) Apply guardrails: 90-day expiry, max $10k per customer, and notify us if usage > 75% in first 30 days.

Jordan — loop in legal if voucher escrow or special T&Cs are required. Camila — can we set the HubSpot deal (RDW-DEAL-2028-0427-CF) to track consumption and billing attribution?

Quick asks: ETA for marketplace visibility and a single voucher code vs two distinct codes?

Thanks,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

On Thu, 22 May 2028 at 10:05, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai wrote:
> Forwarding Priya's request — short timeline. Vanessa, can you confirm whether we can:
>
> 1) Issue $25k in promo credits as a partner-funded pool scoped to CloudNorth/EdgeAccelerator pilots (marketplace voucher or escrowed allocation).

We can do this, but must choose one activation path: marketplace entitlement (faster, tied to partner marketplace listings) or voucher codes (more control). Marketplace entitlement goes live in ~3 business days after ops validation; voucher codes I can provision same day if we have partner PO or legal paperwork.

> 2) Split the allocation 60/40 (CloudNorth 15k / EdgeAccelerator 10k) and surface two redemption paths (marketplace entitlement + per-customer voucher).

Ops prefers: single marketplace entitlement for the cohort (allotted $25k), plus partner-specific voucher codes for top-tier customers we want to limit. That keeps reporting consolidated.

> 3) Apply guardrails: 90-day expiry, max $10k per customer, and notify us if usage > 75% in first 30 days.

Will implement: 90-day TTL, per-customer cap $10k, automated alert at 70% consumption (ops uses alert threshold slightly earlier), and monthly consumption export to the HubSpot deal.

Attachments: I attached the voucher template and the ops checklist we will use for provisioning.

ETA: If Priya can confirm acceptance by EOD Friday (24 May), I can provision marketplace entitlement by Monday 27 May and create two voucher codes same day.

-Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi and Vanessa — CloudNorth accepts the proposed flow (marketplace entitlement + two partner vouchers for priority pilots). We confirm the 60/40 split and the guardrails.

Two quick follow-ups:
- Can you send the voucher codes to me (Priya) and to Mohammed (EdgeAccelerator) only — we will distribute to partner SIs.
- Is there a required PO or MSA to trigger voucher issuance? We have a lightweight co-fund LOA ready if needed.

If you can provision by 27 May that works. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Priya

Quick legal/numbers note: Ops can proceed with marketplace entitlement and vouchers without an updated MSA for promotional credits, but we need a one-page LOA (letter of authorization) documenting the co-fund split, expiry, and responsible party for any overage. Priya — if you can send the LOA (signed or email-confirmed), Ops will treat that as authorization and issue codes to Priya and Mohammed only.

I will also add a small clause to the HubSpot deal to ensure any unconsumed credits are reclaimed after 120 days and returned to the partner pool.

I'll flag the deal RDW-DEAL-2028-0427-CF for finance so cofund accounting is tracked.

-Jordan
